title: Long Division as Orbit + Carry
headline: Long division is best understood as a remainder-orbit system plus carry-propagated block normalization.
status_note: Exact finite-window interfaces are implemented; the global canonical factorization remains `open` under `carry_dfa_factorization`.

featured_searches.label: Orbit/carry frontier
featured_searches.summary: Groups the exact orbit layer, implemented carry layer, open factorization targets, and obstruction families under one exported surface.

featured_searches.label: Orbit/carry trace lens
featured_searches.summary: Experimental finite trace lens for the canonical 21 / 97 / 996 trio, aligning remainder orbit states, raw coefficients, finite carry-window states, and displayed blocks.

featured_searches.label: Visibility Optics workbench
featured_searches.summary: Ranks finite-window evidence for how readable the source remainder orbit is through the carry-propagated block normalization instrument.

featured_searches.label: Base-instrument comparison
featured_searches.summary: Compares Visibility Optics signal classes across base instruments such as 10, 12, and 30 so base choice becomes data rather than a default.

featured_searches.label: Instrument Atlas
featured_searches.summary: Compares base instruments by what they reveal, absorb, distort, or obstruct so working axioms can be revised against finite-window evidence.

featured_searches.label: Chart invariance
featured_searches.summary: Compares base-chart pairs for finite-window invariant candidates and clean distortion witnesses.

featured_searches.label: Carry factorization cases
featured_searches.summary: Keeps the canonical 21 / 97 / 996 carry-DFA comparisons visible as bounded evidence beneath the open factorization claim.

featured_searches.label: Preimage-fiber profile
featured_searches.summary: Makes the finite-window collapse/compression pattern explicit on the selected Track 17 coordinate for canonical cases like 21, 97, and 996.

featured_searches.label: Visible vs hidden quotient obstruction
featured_searches.summary: Splits selected-coordinate quotient-only cases into visible preimage compression versus hidden graph obstruction on the base-10 Track 17 surface.

featured_searches.label: Same-core state-merging families
featured_searches.summary: Tracks same-core disagreement families such as 249 / 498 / 996 and 17 / 34 / 68 / 85 through their selected preimage-fiber profiles.

featured_searches.label: Visible/hidden obstruction families
featured_searches.summary: Groups same-core families by whether they span relabeling, hidden graph obstruction, and visible preimage compression on the selected coordinate.

featured_searches.label: Same-core obstruction correlates
featured_searches.summary: Summarizes empirical correlates separating re-hiding same-core families from one-way visible families at the selected bound.

featured_searches.label: Same-core selector families
featured_searches.summary: Tracks same-core selector-profile disagreement families such as 249 / 498 / 996.

featured_searches.label: Same-core visibility
featured_searches.summary: Compares actual denominators to stripped periodic cores so the exact same-core shift layer stays connected to the frontier.

ladder.label: Exact orbit support
ladder.summary: Remainder periodicity and stripping of base-supported factors fix the exact orbit surface before any carry-normalization claim enters.

ladder.label: Exact block-coordinate support
ladder.summary: The raw coefficient stream is exactly `qk^j`, and the repo only promotes positive-q coordinates once `B > M`.

ladder.label: Implemented finite-window carry support
ladder.summary: Finite-window carry-normalized output, exact incoming-carry boundaries, and same-core shift transport are already exact on named windows.

ladder.label: Obstruction / counterexample surface
ladder.summary: Observed state-map failures now split into visible preimage compression, hidden graph obstruction, and selector-profile disagreement, showing why finite output agreement does not by itself promote to a state-level theorem.

ladder.label: Open factorization targets
ladder.summary: The remaining frontier is an exact visibility threshold and a canonical orbit-plus-carry factorization, both kept explicitly open.
